description: (Recommended for token research) Analyze a Sui coin type or symbol: metadata, current price, 24h change, supply, top holders and current pool-liquidity custody. Verified symbols resolve from the curated list; other mainnet symbols use DexScreener and GeckoTerminal searches confirmed on chain, several exact matches return ambiguous_symbol, and a provider cap or failed confirmation is reported, not read as an absent coin. Pool search covers SUI and native-USDC pairs with per-venue failure reporting. Liquidity custody scans the three pools with the largest SUI or USDC reserve; a stopped holder scan never establishes ownership concentration. Set include_liquidity false to skip pool reads.

holder_max_scan.description: Coin objects and address balances scanned per holder walk (default 2000, max 50000).

holder_time_budget_ms.description: Holder scan wall-clock budget in milliseconds (default 35000, max 600000).

include_holders.description: Include top 5 holders (default: true). Set false for faster response.

include_liquidity.description: Inspect current liquidity and its LP or position holders in up to three discovered pools (default: true). Set false for metadata-only calls.

liquidity_flagged_done.description: Holder-page continuation marker; keep the value from omitted.next_call to avoid repeating flagged holders.

liquidity_holder_pool.description: For a holder continuation, restrict the page to this discovered pool ID.

liquidity_max_scan.description: Max LP coins or position objects scanned per pool (default 1000, max 100000); follow liquidity_custody.pools[].scan.next_call after a bound.

liquidity_offset.description: Start at this holder index within liquidity_holder_pool (default 0).

liquidity_pool_offset.description: Start at this discovered pool after ranking by its current SUI or USDC reserve (default 0).

liquidity_time_budget_ms.description: Wall-clock budget for pool position scans in milliseconds (default 35000, max 600000).

liquidity_venue.description: Search one venue; use pool_discovery.venues[].next_call to continue a bounded venue search.

liquidity_venue_cursor.description: Opaque per-venue cursor; resumes discovery over both SUI and USDC pairs.

query.description: Symbol ('deep') or full coin type ('0x2::sui::SUI'). A symbol matches exactly, in any case; use search_token for partial names.

name: analyze_token
title: Analyze token
